project.title: Metagenomes and metatranscriptomes from tetrachloroethene-dechlorinating consortium SDC-9 growing in the presence and absence of biochar
project.description: The purposel of this study was to retrieve metagenomic and metatranscriptomic sequence information from a consortium (SDC-9) containing organohalide-respiring bacteria (OHRB) that convert teatrachloroethene to ethene. This data is relevant to improving our understanding of the growth of OHRB and supporting microbial community interactions that occur in the presence of chlorinaated ethenes and black carbon materials (e.g., biochar)
